verdict.line: You lose if Darius lands E (Apprehend) and stacks Hemorrhage to five for the enrage; you win if you poke with Q (Corrosive Charge) and W (Purge) from range and never trade autos in melee.

brief.thesis: Urgot's kit is entirely ranged — Q (Corrosive Charge) at 800 range, W (Purge) at 490, even E (Disdain) at 475 — against a champion whose entire kit tops out at 535 range and who needs melee autos to build Hemorrhage stacks. The matchup is decided by whether Darius can close that gap with E before Urgot's poke adds up, which is why the overall shape measures as defensive for Urgot despite the 53.9% win rate.

theirWindow.what: He can hook you from 535 range and force a melee trade. Keep Disdain charged so you can punish the landing, and don't stand in E range just to land an auto.

yourWindow.when: his E (Apprehend) just went on cooldown (16 to 14s)
yourWindow.what: Step up and freely land Q and auto-W pokes since he physically cannot close the distance. This is when you win the wave without risk.

start.why: 86.5% pick rate at 52.3% win rate over 1,759 games — the AD and sustain let you win early auto trades at range before he can engage.

boots.why: 53% win rate over 1,408 games and the clear majority pick (71.7%) — Darius wins through autos and Decimate hits, so flat damage reduction on every one of those blunts his all-in.

core.why: Armor shred lets your ranged poke punch through his stacking armor and amplifies every Q and Purge tick.
The HP and tenacity buffer means one E pull into a Guillotine doesn't just end the trade — you survive it.
58% win rate over 212 games, the strongest of the three core finishers — the speed-up helps you disengage before he stacks Hemorrhage to five.

situational.when: he's building full lifesteal/heal-heavy and you need the grievous wounds to shut off Decimate's healing
their team adds magic damage threats alongside him and you need the dual-resist stack
the lane turns into a prolonged slugfest and you need sustain to out-trade his Hemorrhage bleed over time

runes.keystoneWhy: Landing three consecutive hits from range before he closes in triggers the damage amp and vulnerability — this rewards exactly the kiting pattern you need to win the lane.

summoners.why: 87.5% pick rate at 53.5% win rate — Ignite cuts through Decimate's blade-heal and closes out trades before he reaches max Hemorrhage stacks and the AD enrage.

playing.title: Slow him before he commits E
playing.detail: Land Q (Corrosive Charge) on approach so the slow is already active when he tries to close with E (Apprehend) — it shortens how long he's actually in range of you.

playing.title: Never auto-trade in melee
playing.detail: Every auto he lands is a Hemorrhage stack toward his enrage. Fight at max range with Q and Purge, and walk away rather than standing in his auto range.

playing.title: Track the E cooldown out loud
playing.detail: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — count it down in your head. Step up aggressively the moment it's down, disengage the moment it comes back up.

playing.title: Bail before stack four
playing.detail: Once Hemorrhage hits four stacks he's one hit from enrage and massively bonus AD. Disengage with Disdain or just walk, don't try to out-damage the enrage proc.

playing.title: Respect Decimate's windup, not its range
playing.detail: Q (Decimate) only hits what's in the swing — sidestep during the windup so you take handle damage or nothing instead of the blade, which also denies his heal.

playing.title: Fire R on a losing Darius, not an even one
playing.detail: R (Fear Beyond Death) is a long-cooldown execute threat (100s down to 70s) — only commit it once your poke has him under the execute threshold, since missing it just tells him you're all-in.

playing.title: Back off once his R is up past level 6
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine is true damage and scales with Hemorrhage stacks already on you. If you're under half HP and his ult is available, disengage rather than trading one more auto.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from current-patch games on OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning for why those numbers come out this way — the range gap, the E timer, the Hemorrhage stack threshold — is my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being pulled in with his (E) while maintaining your distance. Bring Ignite to fight aggressively in lane.
